failures.pattern: [38;2;74;222;128m[1m✓[0m reveal shows 1/3 pass count on failure
failures.root_cause: sw-e2e-integration-test fails on GitHub issue creation (likely missing/invalid GitHub auth or API access in CI), cascading to skip the pipeline test; sw-intent-analysis-test fails because analyze_intent's generated JSON is missing required schema fields (version, goal, criteria)
failures.fix: Ensure GitHub credentials/token are configured for e2e integration test environment, and update the intent-analysis schema generator to include version, goal, and criteria fields

failures.root_cause: sw-e2e-integration-test suite exited non-zero during real Claude/GitHub integration checks
failures.fix: inspect sw-e2e-integration-test.sh output/logs for the failing assertion and fix the underlying API or auth handling

failures.pattern: [2m  loop behavior: iterations on test failure[0m
failures.root_cause: sw-intent-analysis-test fails a schema validation assertion (missing version/goal/criteria fields), and sw-e2e-integration-test fails because a prior pipeline lock (pipeline-888) was left in progress, blocking the new pipeline run
failures.fix: Fix analyze_intent output to include required schema fields (version, goal, criteria), and ensure e2e-integration-test cleans up/releases stale pipeline locks before/after each run (e.g. force-abort or unique lock IDs per test)

failures.root_cause: Autoresearch e2e test suite shows all PASS but the aggregate CI summary reports Failed: 1, indicating an unrelated test suite in the full run failed (not captured in this truncated log tail)
failures.fix: Re-run with full untruncated log or scripts/sw-test-all.sh output to identify the specific failing suite, then inspect its FAIL lines directly

failures.fix: Re-run test stage and capture full output including the failing suite name and assertion, or grep sw-test-all.sh output for FAIL/✗ markers
